name: B&H Photo Video (US pro photo / video / broadcast retailer)
price_basis: PNY NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition 96GB GDDR7 bare card, B&H, pre-tax, observed 2026-10-03, listed 'Temporarily Out of Stock'. Range across the RTX PRO 6000 family on the same page: $16,499.00 (PNY Workstation) to $17,499.00 (NVIDIA Max-Q Workstation OEM).
notes: The clearest US pro-audio/video channel and the only large retailer that carries the RTX PRO 6000 line as discrete cards. Two facts matter for availability planning: (1) every RTX 5090 board on the site was 'Temporarily Out of Stock' on 2026-10-03, and (2) a search for RTX 3090 returns no 3090 SKU at all, so the consumer 3090 channel is closed here. B&H also runs a 'Shop Used' channel: RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell listed at $3,299.99 new against $3,002.95 used, and the RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q at $16,623.95 used against $17,499.00 new - roughly 5-6% off for workstation parts, which is not the 40-60% discount the used consumer market offers.
